data.action: 倚靠栏杆仰望夜空巨大月球，指间夹着泛紫光的电子烟，渐变短发随风飘散
data.camera: wide cinematic low angle, grand city and moon backdrop
data.description: 【露西 · 沃森天台的月球凝望与霓虹】夜之城沃森区摩天大楼锈迹斑斑的天台边缘，脚下是无边无际、闪烁着赛博幻彩广告牌的钢铁巨兽之城。露西倚坐在生锈的铁栏杆上，手里夹着一根泛着淡紫荧光的赛博香烟。她抬起头，那对涂着鲜艳红眼影的眸子静静凝望着天幕中洁白无瑕的巨型月球，彩虹渐变的短发在夜风中轻盈飞扬——「总有一天……我会去那里的。离开这个令人窒息的地狱。」
data.lighting: 下方城市汹涌的青蓝紫红霓虹天光与苍白月光交汇
data.location: 沃森区高空大厦废弃天台边缘
data.promptProse: Lucy sits against the rusted Watson rooftop railing, holding a faintly purple cyber cigarette and lifting her red-shadowed eyes toward the great white moon. Keep her netrunner jacket, white bodysuit and dark shorts in the low-angle wide view. The railing crosses the foreground, a neighboring tower overlaps the lower skyline, and progressively smaller illuminated facades open into Night City beyond. Cyan and magenta billboard light rise onto the rail underside and her rainbow hair. Pale moonlight catches her face and upper jacket shoulder; the rooftop immediately beneath her remains darker, grounding the figure against the brilliant city.
data.title: 露西 · 沃森天台的月球凝望与霓虹
